about: Price model for kit quote. Ranges are bands inside what providers and freelancers charge (research/niches/frontdesk.json service_menu); where the band is narrower than the sources, that's a judgment call to keep a first offer easy to say yes to. Tool costs are paid by the client on their own accounts and are not in these prices.

packages.label: Front desk setup
includes: Missed-call text back on their number
Answers to the 10 questions callers ask most
packages.basis: Sources: no setup fee (Nova Solutions) up to $1,000 setup plus monthly (Buldrr) and $2,000 to $4,000 agency builds; GoHighLevel freelancers $300 to $2,500 a project. The $250 to $1,000 band is a judgment call for a first offer.

packages.label: Monthly care: text back, booking and answers
includes: Read the texts every week and fix wrong answers
Keep hours, prices and the booking link current
Same-day fix when a test call fails
packages.basis: Sources: $99 a month (Nova Solutions), from $197 a month (Instant Business Pro), $300 to $500 a month (Buldrr).

packages.label: Monthly care with after-hours answering
includes: After-hours calls answered by an AI receptionist or a live service on their account
packages.basis: Sources: $300 to $500 a month for an agency-run AI receptionist (Buldrr); the answering tool itself is billed to the client (Jobber add-on $29, Rosie from $49, Smith.ai AI from $150).

addons.label: FAQ page for their website from the same answers
Review request text after every finished job

downsell.label: Front desk kit, they set it up
includes: A setup sheet for the tool they pick
downsell.basis: judgment call: a one-time kit for owners who want to do it themselves.
